sentence_stem: The letter had been sent to the wrong address,
full_sentence: The letter had been sent to the wrong address, so the reply never arrived.
acceptable_variants: so we never received an answer.
so the reply was lost in the post.

options.text: although the reply had arrived already.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but a reply arriving before the letter is illogical and does not follow from the stem.

options.text: and the address was written in pen.
options.why_wrong: This describes the letter itself rather than its effect, so it does not complete the cause-and-effect link.

options.text: so the reply was sent to the right address.
options.why_wrong: This would only follow if the letter had reached the right address, which the stem rules out.

grammar_focus: Past perfect passive ('had been sent') with a result clause
explanation: The stem uses the past perfect passive, which describes an action completed before another past event. The completion should show the logical result of the letter going to the wrong place, using a result clause introduced by 'so'.
translation: A carta tinha sido enviada para o endereço errado, então a resposta nunca chegou.
